title: Email List Segments
description: Four club mailing segments, drawn so the overlaps that exist are visible and the one that must not is visibly absent.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Tracking Student Data and Managing Club Communication

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a sample contact, the learner differentiates which segment or segments that contact belongs to.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any circle or overlap for what it is and what you would send to it
pedagogical.assessment: Place a described contact into the right region or regions.
